## Introduction

This analysis compares DNA methylation effect sizes from the AGES cohort (n=2,491) with a whole-genome meta-analysis of ADNI and AIBL studies (n=797).

**Analysis parameters:** Quartile cutoff = `r params$quartile_cutoff`

## Load Data

### AGES cohort association data

```{r}
#| label: load-ages-data

asso <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/whole_genome_wide.rds")) |>
  rename_with(~str_replace(., "nlog10_p_value_(.*)", "\\1_p"), contains("nlog10_p_value")) |>
  rename_with(~str_replace(., "estimate_(.*)", "\\1_es"), contains("estimate"))

glimpse(asso)
```

### ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis data

```{r}
#| label: load-adni-aibl-data

adni_aibl <- read_excel(
  here("data/published_data/MIAMI_AD_database/blood_AD_ADNI_AIBL.xlsx"),
  skip = 3
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    log2_or = log2(estimate),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(pvalue)
  )

glimpse(adni_aibl)
```

## Merge Datasets

```{r}
#| label: merge-data

merged_data <- asso |>
  inner_join(adni_aibl, by = c("cg" = "cpg")) |>
  select(
    cg,
    # AGES effect sizes
    prev_es, mci2incid_es, normal2incid_es, normal2mci_es, stable_mci_es,
    # AGES p-values
    prev_p, mci2incid_p, normal2incid_p, normal2mci_p, stable_mci_p,
    # ADNI/AIBL data
    chr, pos, log2_or, pvalue, fdr, neg_log10_p
  )

cat("Number of overlapping CpGs:", nrow(merged_data), "\n")
```

## Define Significance Thresholds

```{r}
#| label: define-thresholds

# Cutoff values (used to create threshold labels dynamically)
cutoff_values <- c(4.5, 4, 3.5, 3, 2.5, 2)
p_thresholds <- set_names(10^-cutoff_values, cutoff_values)
```

## Correlation Analysis

### Prepare data for visualization

```{r}
#| label: prepare-facet-data

# Create long format data for facet_grid
facet_data <- map_dfr(names(p_thresholds), function(cutoff_value) {
  threshold_value <- p_thresholds[[cutoff_value]]

  filtered_data <- merged_data |>
    filter(pvalue < threshold_value)

  if (nrow(filtered_data) < 10) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  n_cg <- nrow(filtered_data)

  filtered_data |>
    select(cg, log2_or, prev_es, mci2incid_es, normal2incid_es, stable_mci_es, normal2mci_es) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = ends_with("_es"),
      names_to = "demcat",
      values_to = "ages_effect_size"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      demcat = str_remove(demcat, "_es"),
      cutoff_value = as.numeric(cutoff_value),
      threshold_value = threshold_value,
      n_cpgs = n_cg,
      # Format: Threshold: x with (N_CpG=X,XXX) on second line
      pval_cutoff = glue(
        "Threshold: {cutoff_value}<br><span style='font-size:6.5pt'>(N<sub>CpG</sub>={format(n_cg, big.mark = ',')})</span>"
      )
    )
}) |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev", "stable_mci", "normal2mci"),
    pval_cutoff = fct_reorder(pval_cutoff, -cutoff_value)
  )

# Save pre-quartile-filtered facet_data for standalone directionality analysis
write_rds(facet_data, here("validation/output/facet_data_pre_filter_ADNI_AIBL.rds"))

# Apply quartile filtering per sub-dataset (cutoff_value + demcat)
if (params$quartile_cutoff < 1) {
  lower_q <- (1 - params$quartile_cutoff) / 2
  upper_q <- 1 - lower_q

  facet_data <- facet_data |>
    mutate(
      x_lower = quantile(ages_effect_size, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      x_upper = quantile(ages_effect_size, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_lower = quantile(log2_or, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_upper = quantile(log2_or, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = c(cutoff_value, demcat)
    ) |>
    filter(
      ages_effect_size >= x_lower & ages_effect_size <= x_upper,
      log2_or >= y_lower & log2_or <= y_upper
    ) |>
    select(-x_lower, -x_upper, -y_lower, -y_upper)
}

# Create correlation labels for each facet with parsed expressions
facet_correlations <- facet_data |>
  summarise(
    cor_test = list(cor.test(ages_effect_size, log2_or, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
    n_cpgs = n_distinct(cg),
    pval_cutoff = first(pval_cutoff),
    .by = c(cutoff_value, demcat)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cor_estimate = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.$estimate),
    cor_pval = map_dbl(cor_test, ~.$p.value),
    # Parsed expression labels for italic r and P
    cor_estimate_label = glue("italic(r) == ~{round(cor_estimate, 2)}"),
    cor_pval_label = glue("italic(P) == ~{display_scientific_notation(cor_pval)}")
  ) |>
  select(-cor_test) |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev", "stable_mci", "normal2mci"),
    pval_cutoff = fct_reorder(pval_cutoff, -cutoff_value)
  )
```

### Prepare directionality data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-directionality-data

directionality_data <- facet_data |>
  mutate(
    ages_direction = sign(ages_effect_size),
    adni_direction = sign(log2_or),
    concordant = ages_direction == adni_direction & ages_direction != 0 & adni_direction != 0
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_concordant = sum(concordant, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_discordant = n_total - n_concordant,
    prop_concordant = n_concordant / n_total,
    .by = c(cutoff_value, demcat, pval_cutoff)
  )
```

### Create validation scatter plot (all 5 transitions)

```{r}
#| label: fig-altogether
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 14

altogether_plot <- facet_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ages_effect_size, y = log2_or)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Correlation coefficient (r) with parsed expression

  geom_label(
    data = facet_correlations,
    aes(label = cor_estimate_label),
    x = I(0.05),
    y = I(0.95),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    color = "darkred",
    fill = "grey90",
    label.size = NA,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  # P-value with parsed expression
  geom_label(
    data = facet_correlations,
    aes(label = cor_pval_label),
    x = I(0.05),
    y = I(0.80),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    color = "darkred",
    fill = "grey90",
    label.size = NA,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(pval_cutoff),
    cols = vars(demcat),
    scales = "free",
    # switch = "y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = glue("Effect size of AGES cohort <br> <span style = 'font-size:9pt'>(N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 2,491)</span>"),
    y = "Effect size of ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis <br> <span style = 'font-size:9pt'>(N<sub>Subjects</sub> = 797)</span>",
    title = "Whole-Genome EWAS Comparison: AGES vs ADNI/AIBL Meta-Analysis",
    subtitle = "Correlations across dementia categories and significance thresholds"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_textbox(halign = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_textbox(halign = 0.5, orientation = "left-rotated"),
    strip.text.x = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5, lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(8, 2, 2, 2)),
    # strip.text.y.left = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 2)),
    strip.text.y = element_textbox_simple(halign = 0.5, orientation = "right-rotated", lineheight = 1.2, margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 2)),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
  )

print(altogether_plot)
```

### Three transitions scatter plot (all thresholds)

Filter to show only prev, mci2incid, and normal2incid transitions (omitting stable_mci and normal2mci).

